purpose: Teach: 栄誉/誤字/身辺/原資/無形/物欲/申し込む/差し出す

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 優秀社員には栄誉を讃えるべきね
lines.en: We should recognize and honor our top performers.
lines.style: Clear and measured, like an opening proposal. Steady tone, conversational pace. A light emphasis on 'recognize'—the conviction of someone who's thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料の誤字を再点検します
lines.en: Yes. I'll do a careful recheck of the document for typos.
lines.style: Attentive, no hesitation. Quick acknowledgment, then moves into the detail with quiet efficiency. Professional but not stiff—the tone of someone ready to take action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 役員の身辺警備を強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's also strengthen security measures for the executive team.
lines.style: Confident delivery, forward-leaning. Each phrase lands with intention. No uncertainty—this is a directive, but spoken as collaboration, not command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規プロジェクトの原資を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll verify the budget allocation for the new project.
lines.style: Prompt, engaged. Acknowledges immediately, then notes the next step with calm focus. The rhythm of someone taking notes mentally as they speak.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、無形ブランドの強化に取り組みましょう
lines.en: We should invest in strengthening our brand's intangible value.
lines.style: Thoughtful opening. Slower pace—this is the bigger picture. Slight weight on 'intangible'—it matters that people understand what she means, not just the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修で物欲ではない価値観を伝えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the training program emphasizes values beyond material gain.
lines.style: Engaged and specific. No rush. Shows she understands the meaning behind the directive, not just the words. Steady, reflective pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新サービス申し込む手続きを簡素化しましょう
lines.en: Let's simplify the application process for our new service.
lines.style: Pragmatic and direct. Medium pace, clear enunciation. The tone of someone solving a real problem. Slight warmth—this benefits the customer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様に資料を差し出す手順を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll streamline the steps for getting materials to customers.
lines.style: Final confirmation, with closure. Calm and assured. A touch of finality in the pacing—the last point of the meeting. Still engaged, but settling into resolution.
